as per Government of India instructions.

General/EWS category: minimum 40% marks SC/ST/OBC categories: minimum 35% marks PwBD candidates: minimum qualifying marks as prescribed for their respective caste category (General/SC/ST/OBC) Reserved category candidates applying against an unreserved (UR) post: minimum 40% for all categories

how_to_apply: PGIMER Nursing Officer Apply Online process is entirely online; no offline application form or downloaded/printed application copy will be accepted.
Visit the official PGIMER website: www.pgimer.edu.in and go to the Recruitment link on the Home Page.

Complete Online Registration by filling mandatory details: Advertisement Number, Advertisement Date, Name of Applicant (as per matriculation certificate), Date of Birth (as per matriculation certificate), Mobile Number, and Email ID. These details cannot be changed once registered.
Login using the User ID and password received on the registered email and mobile number, then click "Go to Application Form".
Fill the section-wise Application Form covering personal information, qualification(s), experience(s), and upload of documents/certificates. Use "Save and Next" to move between sections.
Upload a recent, unattested, scanned photograph in JPG/JPEG format (50–80 KB), snapped on or after 1st July 2026, with the candidate's name and date of taking the photograph clearly visible on it.

Upload legible scanned copies of certificates/documents supporting educational qualification (from Matric onwards), mark sheets, date of birth proof, category certificate (SC/ST/OBC/PwBD, where applicable), experience certificate(s), and NOC from present employer (if employed).
Indicate your preferred examination city carefully, as it cannot be changed later.
Click Submit after completing all sections, and proceed to pay the applicable application fee through Net Banking, Credit Card, or Debit Card.
Take a printout of the completed application form for future reference and document verification.

Candidates already in government/semi-government/autonomous body employment must forward their application through proper channel to the Administrative Officer, Recruitment Cell of the Institute, within 10 days after the last date fixed for online submission; the online application is treated as an advance copy.
important_instructions: Candidates may apply for more than one post if otherwise eligible, but must pay the prescribed fee separately for each. No request for change of any particulars (name, date of birth, category, qualification, marks, photo, signature, etc.) will be entertained after submission of the application form. SC/ST/OBC candidates must upload the requisite Caste Certificate; OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) candidates need a certificate issued between 01.04.2026 and 03.10.2026, in the format at Annexure-I, along with a declaration as per Annexure-II at the time of document verification. EWS candidates must produce an Income and Asset Certificate (valid for year 2026-27) issued between 01.04.2026 and 03.10.2026 by a Competent Authority, in the format at Annexure-III. Family gross annual income must be below Rs. 8 lakh, and specified land/property holding limits must not be exceeded. PwBD candidates must have a minimum of 40% benchmark disability and submit the requisite disability certificate; scribe/reader/compensatory time facility is available subject to conditions and advance intimation to PGIMER via [email protected]. Central Government Civilian Employees seeking age relaxation must submit the certificate as per Annexure-VI and a No Objection Certificate from their employer. Roll Numbers/Admit Cards will be available for download approximately one week before the exam and will not be sent by post. Candidates are prohibited from carrying mobile phones, wrist watches, wallets, jewellery, or any electronic device into the examination hall. Result will be declared only on the PGIMER website; no individual intimation will be sent at any stage. There is no provision for re-checking or re-evaluation of answer sheets. Candidature of applicants is purely provisional at all stages of the recruitment process and can be cancelled at any stage if found ineligible. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the applicant.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Nursing Officer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: PGIMER Nursing Officer eligibility 2026 is based on educational qualification, professional registration, and (for some candidates) experience, along with the prescribed age limit. Candidates must possess one of the following qualification combinations: Option A: B.Sc. (Hons) in Nursing from a recognized University or Institute, OR Regular course in B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized University or Institute, OR Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing from a recognized University or Institute; AND Registered as a Nurse or Nurse and mid-wife (RN or RN & RM) with a State Nursing Council. Option B: Diploma in General Nursing and Mid-wifery (GNM) from a recognized Board or Council; Registered as a Nurse or Nurse and mid-wife from a State Nursing Council; AND one year of experience in a minimum fifty-bedded hospital after acquiring the above qualification. Unless diplomas/degrees obtained through Open and Distance Learning mode are recognized for the relevant period as per the Ministry of Education Notification dated 10.06.2015, they will not be accepted for the purpose of educational qualification.

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Nursing Officer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The age limit for PGIMER Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026 is 18 to 35 years, calculated as on the last date of submission of the online application, i.e., 03.10.2026. Date of Birth as recorded in the Matriculation/Secondary Examination Certificate will be accepted; no subsequent request for change will be considered. Note: No age relaxation is available to reserved category candidates applying against an unreserved (UR) vacancy. Age relaxation for PwBD and Central Government Civilian Employees will not be considered together; only the more beneficial relaxation among the two will be allowed. The maximum age of a PwBD applicant after relaxation shall not exceed 56 years on the crucial date. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

faq.question: Q1. What is PGIMER Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education & Research (PGIMER), Chandigarh, under Advertisement No. PGI/RC/055/2026/2276 dated 09.09.2026, to fill 243 posts of Nursing Officer (Group 'B') on a direct recruitment basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in PGIMER Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 243 vacancies have been announced (UR-99, SC-36, ST-18, OBC-66, EWS-24), including 10 posts earmarked for PwBD candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for PGIMER Nursing Officer 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration and submission of the application is 03.10.2026. Online registration opens on 10.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for PGIMER Nursing Officer?
faq.answer: Candidates need B.Sc. (Hons) Nursing / Regular B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing with RN or RN & RM registration, OR a GNM Diploma with State Nursing Council registration plus one year of experience in a minimum fifty-bedded hospital.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for PGIMER Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 35 years as on the last date of submission of the online application (03.10.2026), with age relaxation applicable to SC/ST, OBC, PwBD, Central Government employees, PGIMER employees, and Ex-Servicemen as per prescribed norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for PGIMER Nursing Officer 2026?
faq.answer: PwBD candidates are exempted from fee. SC/ST candidates must pay Rs. 800/- plus transaction charges, while General/OBC/EWS candidates must pay Rs. 1500/- plus transaction charges.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for PGIMER Nursing Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must visit www.pgimer.edu.in, complete online registration, fill the section-wise application form, upload required documents and photograph, and pay the application fee through Net Banking/Credit Card/Debit Card before the closing date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for PGIMER Nursing Officer?
faq.answer: Selection is based solely on a Computer Based Test (CBT) of 100 MCQs/100 marks with negative marking, followed by shortlisting, document verification, and final merit-based selection. There is no interview for this Group 'B' post.
